name: Cordon of Arrows
material: four or more arrows or bolts
description: Plant up to four nonmagical Arrows or Bolts in your space and designate creatures the spell should ignore. When another creature first enters or ends a turn within 30 feet, one piece flies at it; a failed Dexterity save deals 2d4 Piercing damage and destroys that ammunition. The spell ends when none remain. **Higher-Level Slots.** Affect two additional pieces per slot level above 2.
